text.tspan: BREADBOARD — what you actually build (video amp, bias, power, harness)
Mixer IF in on a shielded pigtail. 49.9 R + 1 nF FIRST, right at the input.
U1A gain 1+R3/R4 = 101 (4.7k here -> 22 for first power-up)
12 V in -> D1 -> VPROT -> R15/C13 -> VANA (op-amp rail, ~11 V)
100 nF at each TL072 V+ pin
5 V from the LM2596, ferrite + 10u + 100n per RF module
ESP32 harness (J9) -> ADF4351 logic (J10, 33 R series) and A4988 logic (J11)
EN pull-up = motor off until firmware
SYSTEM — what the breadboard connects to (all 2.4 GHz on SMA coax, never on the breadboard)
fuse 1 A in the +12 V lead
IF -> shielded pigtail -> J1 on the breadboard
VMOT from the fused 12 V, NOT through D1. MS1-3 high = 1/16 step. VREF for ~0.8 A.
L = beat 0-2.6 kHz, R = sync. 44.1 kHz 16-bit. radar_acquire.py
Nets with the same label are connected across both halves (KiCad local labels).
Sweep 2440-2480 MHz (drone WiFi on ch 1), 64 steps x 100 us, PRI 7.4 ms. Boots RF OFF.
